> 第730章 冲动跳下（第1页）
少年带着五名亲信纵身跃下城墙的一幕，很快被附近值守的修士捕捉，消息顺着城头飞快传开，四门守军人心顿时掀起一阵波澜。
西门余下的魔族修士最先陷入混乱。
留守的魔族长老闻讯立刻冲到垛口，望着下方翻涌的黑雾，脸色铁青。
长老一早便叮嘱过这名少年首领切勿冲动，奈何少年心气高傲，盟约商议之时不愿亲自参会，对敌策与风险警示一知半解，如今又被虚空浊气搅动心神，做出这般铤而走险的举动。
不少魔族修士心绪复杂，一部分人暗自担忧，少年乃是魔族重点培养的后辈，若是折损在外，对魔族而言是巨大损失。
也有一部分人心生不满，眼下联军防线本就承受重压，贸然带队出城，等于凭空撕开一处防守缺口，极易引来异兽集中冲击。
还有少数被浊气影响的魔族，心底生出怨怼，下意识揣测是不是其他族群暗中施压，才逼得少年主动出击，险些滋生出新的矛盾。
隔壁区段值守的妖族修士很快听闻动静。不少妖修面露错愕，一时间难以理解这般莽撞的选择。
北门妖族首领眉头紧锁，他清楚夜间域外异兽层层密布，脱离城墙防线等于自陷重围。
一部分妖族心中生出戒备，暗自提防魔族会不会另有图谋，借着出城行动暗中调动人手。
但更多亲历过白日联防配合的妖修十分清醒，明白这仅仅是少年一时冲动，若是魔族防线因此崩溃，兽潮顺势登上城头，妖族侧翼同样会承受巨大压力，连忙主动派人留意西门衔接地带，随时准备支援。
东门方向，秦晏之收到消息，神色瞬间凝重。
他方才刚刚警示众人提防暗处偷袭，转眼西门便生出变故。
人族修士议论纷纷，不少人摇头叹息，认为少年太过年轻，沉不住心性，不懂隐忍御敌的道理。
一同驻守的巡查修士迅速互通消息，不少人暗暗绷紧神经，警惕异动引来异兽强攻。
秦晏之立刻传令东门靠近西门的人族修士向西侧靠拢，填补魔族因人员空缺出现的防线空隙，防止意外扩大。
依附城墙边角驻守的草木精怪心中满是不安。它们本体孱弱，最惧怕防线出现缺口。
在灵体长老看来，各族缔结盟约正是为了彼此依托，固守城墙才是上策，贸然出城无异于自寻死路。

藤皇舒展细微藤蔓，不断探查西门外侧的气息，草木本源感知到城外愈发浓郁的凶煞之气，持续散出淡淡的清气，安抚周边心神动荡的精怪，同时悄悄延伸枝蔓，盯紧那处空出的垛口，防备异兽借着缺口攀上城头。
短暂的骚动过后，各族修士依旧没有放下手中兵刃，正面的异兽浪潮还在持续冲击城墙。
只是所有人心底都悬起一块巨石，一边奋力斩杀身前异兽，一边不自觉留意西门之外的黑暗。
谁也无法预料，这名冲动出城的魔族少年，将会给这座勉强维系平衡的孤城，带来怎样难以挽回的变数。

> Chapter 730 Jumping off impulse (page 1)
The scene of the young man jumping off the city wall with five of his confidants was quickly captured by the monks on duty nearby. The news spread quickly along the city wall, and the hearts of the four gatekeepers suddenly felt a wave of excitement.
The remaining demon monks in Ximen were the first to fall into chaos.
After hearing the news, the demon elders who stayed behind immediately rushed to the crenel and looked at the billowing black mist below, their faces livid.
The elder had warned the young leader early in the morning not to be impulsive. However, the young man was arrogant and unwilling to participate in the meeting in person during the treaty negotiations. He had little understanding of the enemy's strategies and risk warnings. Now, his mind was disturbed by the turbid air of the void, and he made such a desperate and risky move.
Many demon monks have complicated emotions, and some people are secretly worried. The young man is the younger generation that the demon clan focuses on training. If he is damaged, it will be a huge loss to the demon clan.
There are also some people who are dissatisfied. The coalition defense line is already under heavy pressure. Leading the team out of the city rashly is equivalent to opening a defensive gap out of thin air, which can easily attract the concentrated attack of alien beasts.
There were also a few demons affected by the turbid energy who felt resentful in their hearts. They subconsciously speculated whether it was secret pressure from other ethnic groups that forced the young man to take the initiative, almost creating new conflicts.
The demon monks on duty in the next section quickly heard the news. Many demon cultivators looked astonished and found it difficult to understand such a reckless choice.
The leader of the Beimen Monster Clan frowned. He knew that there were densely populated alien beasts at night, and leaving the city wall defenses would mean that he was trapped in a tight siege.
Some of the demon clan were on guard, secretly wary of whether the demon clan had other plans, and secretly mobilized manpower through the operation out of the city.
However, more demon cultivators who had experienced joint defense cooperation during the day were very clear-headed and understood that this was just a boy's impulse. If the demon clan's defense line collapsed and the beast tide climbed onto the city, the demon clan's flanks would also be under tremendous pressure. They quickly sent people to pay attention to the west gate connection zone and be ready to support at any time.
In the direction of the east gate, Qin Yanzhi received the news and his expression became solemn.
He had just warned everyone to beware of sneak attacks in the dark, but something happened to Ximen in the blink of an eye.
The human monks talked a lot, and many people shook their heads and sighed, thinking that the young man was too young, could not calm his mind, and did not understand the principle of forbearance to defend against the enemy.
The patrolling monks who were stationed together quickly exchanged news, and many people secretly tensed up their nerves, wary of any unusual movements that might lead to an attack by strange beasts.
Qin Yanzhi immediately ordered the human monks near the east gate and the west gate to move closer to the west to fill the gap in the demon defense line caused by the vacancy of personnel and prevent accidental expansion.
The grass and tree spirits stationed at the corners of the city wall were filled with uneasiness. Their bodies are weak, and they are most afraid of gaps in their defense line.
In the view of the spiritual elders, the alliance between the various tribes was formed just to rely on each other, and sticking to the city wall was the best option. Leaving the city rashly was tantamount to seeking death.
The Vine Emperor stretched out its tiny vines and constantly probed for the aura outside the west gate. The roots of the vegetation sensed the increasingly intense ominous aura outside the city, and continued to emit a light fresh air to calm the restless spirits around. At the same time, he quietly extended the branches and vines, keeping an eye on the empty crenel to prevent strange beasts from climbing up the city through the gap.
After the brief commotion, the monks of all races still did not put down their weapons, and the wave of alien beasts from the front continued to hit the city wall.
But everyone had a huge boulder hanging in their hearts. While they struggled to kill the strange beasts in front of them, they unconsciously paid attention to the darkness outside the west gate.
No one could predict what kind of irreversible changes this demon boy who impulsively left the city would bring to this isolated city that was barely maintaining balance.
